_: Reference app matrix (EV-001). Which kinds of project the kit has actually been proven on, and which it has not. scripts/check-reference-matrix.js checks every in-repository app exists and prints the empty cells, so a gap is a line of output rather than an assumption. 'external' apps live outside this repository and are recorded with the evidence of what was done there.

apps.proves: One Next.js + PostgreSQL CRUD app to R3 in a clean environment (PP-003), with the full evidence set EP-002..007.
A second web stack with a separate Python API to R3 (PP-004).
An offline-first mobile client with a sync API to R3 (PP-005).
Adoption of a mature monorepo the kit did not write (EV-009): Phase A 7/7, R2 10/10 with local clean-checkout CI, eval baseline 2/5, fourteen findings fed back into the kit.
